name: bland
description: Build, test, and run Bland voice agents from your coding agent: the hosted Bland MCP server plus skills for pathways, analytics, evals, call review, tools, personas, knowledge bases, and automations, and the Norm agent builder with a self-driving convergence loop.

bland_api_key.title: Bland API key
bland_api_key.description: Your Bland API key from app.bland.ai/settings/api-keys. Masked on entry and stored encrypted in the OS keychain.

bland_api_url.title: Bland API URL (optional)
bland_api_url.description: Optional. Defaults to production (https://api.bland.ai); only set this to point at a dev/staging server. Not a secret.
